description: List the crawl sessions stored for this account, newest last, with their session_id, start URL, start and end times, and page count. Single-page checks made with check_page are not crawls and are not listed. Call this first when the user refers to "the last crawl" or when you need a session_id for issues_summary, query_issues, page_report or compare_crawls. A session with no end time is still running or was interrupted.
name: list_crawls
